vopros: What are the best language immersion preschools in Westwood, Los Angeles?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Based on current listings and reviews, here are some of the top language immersion preschool options in and around Westwood, Los Angeles:

## 1. WorldSpeak Preschool (Westwood Blvd)
This is one of the most well-known multilingual preschools in the area. WorldSpeak is a multilingual preschool with French, Russian, Mandarin, Spanish, and Ukrainian immersion programs. Their unique approach features native-speaking teachers, helping young students become bilingual before entering elementary school, and they've been open for over two decades, nurturing over 2,500 young minds.

Parents specifically praise the program, noting "The teachers and director at WorldSpeak are wonderful... Our son is in the Spanish immersion program." The school also emphasizes a curriculum with critical thinking and social skills, plus advanced math and chess programs alongside multilingual immersion. They have a main location at 1639 Westwood Blvd and a second location at 2387 Malcolm Ave in West LA.

Language options at WorldSpeak include French, English, Chinese (Mandarin or Cantonese), Russian, Ukrainian, and Spanish.

## 2. Saint Sebastian School (West LA/Westwood area)
This Catholic preschool offers a dedicated Spanish immersion track. It's a private, Catholic coed preschool in West Los Angeles for 2 and 3 year olds with Spanish language immersion. Their teaching method is notable: teachers speak to children completely in Spanish to create an immersion experience, using gestures, actions, and pictures so students understand — a method called comprehensible input.

Parent reviews are strongly positive, describing it as "a wonderful school for all of students... all of teachers are nice, passionate and professional. They always give kids a warm hug when they need it."

## 3. Intiwasi Spanish Immersion School
Highly rated on Niche, this school has an enthusiastic parent following. One parent shared: "We absolutely love Intiwasi Spanish Immersion School! The program is truly exceptional—my daughter surprises me every day with how much she has learned... especially in Spanish." Another highlight is the staff quality: "The teachers are incredibly kind, caring, and dedicated. You can tell they genuinely love what they do and create such a nurturing environment for the kids." Even the meals get praise: "The food is another highlight—always fresh, nutritious, and thoughtfully prepared."

## 4. Smaller Bilingual/In-Home Options
For families interested in a more intimate setting, there's an in-home, bilingual family daycare located near the intersection of Santa Monica Boulevard and Westwood Boulevard. Some in-home programs also offer broader exposure — one nearby option includes foreign language classes in French, Spanish, and Armenian.

---

### Quick Comparison
| School | Languages | Highlight |
|---|---|---|
| WorldSpeak | French, Russian, Mandarin, Spanish, Ukrainian | Most language options; 20+ years experience |
| Saint Sebastian | Spanish | Faith-based, comprehensible input method |
| Intiwasi | Spanish | Highly praised by parents on Niche |
| In-home programs | Varies (French, Spanish, Armenian) | Smaller, family-style setting |

### My Recommendation
If you want the **widest language selection**, WorldSpeak is the standout choice given its long track record and five language programs. If you're specifically focused on **Spanish immersion** and prefer either a faith-based environment or strong parent testimonials, Saint Sebastian or Intiwasi are excellent picks. I'd suggest touring 2-3 of these in person, since immersion quality (native-speaker ratio, how much English "leaks in") varies a lot and is best judged firsthand.
